projects.name: Tasker
projects.subtitle: Family Task Adventure
projects.tagline: Turns household chores into a game kids actually want to play.
projects.description: A delightfully playful, production-grade family app. Parents hand out missions, kids tap “I did it!” to a burst of confetti and collect stars, and daily streaks keep the momentum going. Behind the candy-coloured interface sits serious engineering: role-based security, rate limiting, hashed credentials and 100% test coverage enforced in CI on both frontend and backend.
features: One-time, repeating and taking-turns chores with automatic rotation
Stars, daily streaks and a family leaderboard
Mobile-first and installable as an app (PWA)
Email notifications for new tasks, turns and completions
Three roles: admin, parent and child

projects.name: Yoga DB
projects.subtitle: Asanas, flows & games
projects.tagline: A beautifully curated yoga encyclopedia that teaches while it delights.
projects.description: An elegant full-stack library of hand-curated asanas, each with photography, Sanskrit and English names, difficulty and benefits, woven together through transitions, flows and classes. Learning games turn Sanskrit memorisation into play, and community ratings surface the poses people love most. Backed by automated off-site backups and a separate QA environment.
features: Every pose photographed, with Sanskrit and English names
Transitions, flows and full classes built from poses
Four learning games: match poses and master Sanskrit

projects.name: Rocket Builder Tycoon
projects.subtitle: A Roblox tycoon game
projects.tagline: Design it. Launch it. Upgrade it. Repeat until orbit.
projects.description: A Roblox tycoon where players assemble rockets from interchangeable parts, launch them in a blaze of visual effects and reinvest the earnings in ever-better hardware. A tight engineering-meets-economy loop, already covered by its own test suites.
features: Modular rockets: nose cones, bodies, fuel tanks, engines and fins

projects.name: Spotify to Chords
projects.subtitle: Playlist → guitar songbook
projects.tagline: Turn any Spotify playlist into a printable guitar songbook.
projects.description: Sign in with Spotify, pick a playlist or your Liked Songs, and Songbook finds the chords for every track: first in a shared chord library, then across 17 chord sites, keeping the best match per song. The result is a PDF songbook with a clickable index and one song per page, with transposition, version choices and a list of anything still missing. Each visitor's data stays private, with invite-based Spotify access and 100% test coverage enforced in CI.
features: Per-user Spotify sign-in for playlists and Liked Songs
Chord search across a shared library and many chord sites
Printable PDF songbook with index, one song per page
Transpose, pick between versions, ban bad tabs
CSV upload works without signing in
